response.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS analysis_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS r ON a.translink = r.transreg JOIN trader AS t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), shares AS (SELECT tradekind, analysis_count, analysis_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(analysis_count) FROM type_counts) AS share FROM type_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS share_average FROM shares) SELECT s.tradekind, s.analysis_count, s.share, s.share - a.share_average AS share_above_average FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN average_share AS a WHERE s.share > a.share_average;
